d:
From construction dust in Mumbai and deteriorating air quality in Kolkata to diesel buses in Guwahati and industrial pollution complaints in Assam, environmental concerns are increasingly finding their way into courtrooms.
Across the country, High Courts have questioned government inaction, sought explanations from pollution-control authorities and issued directions on pollution and environmental protection. Their interventions have ranged from monitoring air-quality measures and regulating polluting activities to protecting urban green spaces and exploring cleaner transport.
